title: 义务教育教科书·英语（译林）三年级下册

sentences.en: What is that?

sentences.cn: 这是我的钢笔，这是我的铅笔。
sentences.en: This is my pen and this is my pencil.

sentences.cn: 把直尺和橡皮放进你的铅笔盒里。
sentences.en: Put the ruler and the rubber in your pencil case.
My schoolbag is long and big.
Guess again!
I have many school things.

sentences.cn: 我们把教室打扫干净吧。
sentences.en: Let us clean our classroom.
Close the window and clean the blackboard.
Put away your books and sweep the floor.
The desk and the chair are dirty.
Please keep the classroom clean.

sentences.cn: 在图书馆里不要大声叫嚷，也不要说话。
sentences.en: Don’t shout or talk in the library.
Don’t run and don’t be late.
Mrs Li says, “Sit down, please.”
Shh! Be quiet.
Look at the bird.
Don’t eat sweets in class.

sentences.cn: 不要往窗外看。要遵守规则。
sentences.en: Don’t look out of the window. Follow the rules.
The book is on the desk.
The game is fun.

sentences.cn: 课间休息时我们在外面玩。
sentences.en: At break time we play outside.
The butterfly is beautiful.

sentences.cn: 花园里有一朵漂亮的花。
sentences.en: There is a nice flower in the garden.
The duck is under the tree.
The student is behind the desk.

sentences.cn: 我们去花园旁边的美术社团。
sentences.en: We go to the Art Club by the garden.

sentences.cn: 公园不太远，课也结束了。
sentences.en: The park is not very far, and the class is over.

sentences.cn: 你准备好了吗？我来自中国。
sentences.en: Are you ready? I am from China.
We have fun after class.

sentences.cn: 我的纸飞机在哪儿？我找不到它。
sentences.en: Where is my paper plane? I cannot find it.

sentences.cn: 你觉得这部电影怎么样？
sentences.en: What do you think of the film?

sentences.cn: 我有一个苹果和一根香蕉。
sentences.en: I have an apple and a banana.
The orange and the grapes are sweet.
This salad is very good.
Let’s make a cake together.

sentences.cn: 我们分享水果，他们很开心。
sentences.en: We share the fruit, and they are happy.
I like mangoes very much.

sentences.cn: 在农场里我能看见一头奶牛和一只羊。
sentences.en: On the farm I can see a cow and a sheep.
The pig and the rabbit are very cute.
A chicken is eating a carrot.

sentences.cn: 这些盒子大，那些盒子小。
sentences.en: These boxes are big, and those are small.
Help me move the box to my home.

sentences.cn: 在动物园里我们能看见猴子、狮子和熊。
sentences.en: At the zoo we can see a monkey, a lion and a bear.

sentences.cn: 老虎和熊猫都是大动物。
sentences.en: The tiger and the panda are big animals.
The elephant is very big.
At lunchtime I feed the fish.

sentences.cn: 我们过去跟他击个掌吧。
sentences.en: Let’s go and give him a high five.

sentences.cn: 这只小变色龙是什么颜色的？
sentences.en: What colour is the little chameleon?

sentences.cn: 太阳是红的，天空是蓝的。
sentences.en: The sun is red and the sky is blue.
The grass is green and the flower is yellow.

sentences.cn: 她的包是粉色的，他的是棕色的。
sentences.en: Her bag is pink and his is brown.
The panda is black and white.

sentences.cn: 当然，你可以拿一个橙色的。
sentences.en: Sure, you can have an orange one.
Can I buy a balloon?
